description: Agent Risk: submit one planned action and where value already sits: the action with its id, where it puts value (such as one supplier, one wallet or one provider), the kind of place (a wallet, a vendor, a position, a provider, a counterparty or other), who stands behind that place when it differs (such as the custodian or the parent company), what it puts there, its unit and its description; each holding with its id, place, kind, owner, amount and unit (an empty list when nothing is held); and optionally the most one place or owner may hold as a share of the total (50 when left out) and the share that counts as elevated (25 when left out). The signed report gives the action, every place with what it holds before and after the action, its shares and its status as over_cap, elevated, spread or unread, the shares before and after for the action’s place and for its owner across every place it stands behind, and counts the places, the holdings counted and those of another kind or unit, and names an excessive concentration: the action’s place over the cap after the action, and its owner over the cap across its places; then a share at or above the elevated line, an action that adds to the place already holding the most and another place already over the cap, with the fix for each. Holdings of the action’s kind and unit are counted, places compared as plain words. This reads where one action puts value against the spread already held, beside the counterparty quality the wever_vendor checks read: stated concentration caps per asset or chain against current balances are wever_treasury-policy-check, a vendor’s lock-in and exit terms are wever_vendor-lockin-check and a counterparty’s stated identity against its evidence is wever_vendor-identity-check. Verdict risk_concentration_excessive, risk_concentration_elevated, risk_concentration_unknown or risk_concentration_spread. POST /api/risk-concentration-check. Reads only the recorded material about the planned action in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, configuration change or external write; the planned action is not taken, paused, approved or undone and no limit, position or dependency is changed. Agent Risk reads the consequences of an action the agent plans to take, before it takes it: how much it puts at stake against the agent’s limits, whether it can be undone, how far a failure would spread beyond its target, the worst credible outcome against what the principal can absorb, whether it piles value into one place, what it depends on staying available or true, whether acting now is itself the risk and whether repeating or chaining it multiplies the risk. It is not confidence in information (the wever_uncertainty checks read how sure the information behind a decision is; a risk check reads what the action costs if it goes wrong: uncertainty is about what the agent knows, risk is about what the action can do), not permission (wever_consent-scope-check reads whether the principal’s grant covers a use and wever_authority-scope-check reads whether the agent may act at all; a risk check reads the consequences of an action already permitted, and a permission never makes an action safe), not an agreement’s exposure (wever_negotiation-risk-check reads the value handed over before a counterparty pays under one proposed agreement; a risk check reads one action the agent is about to take) and not sorting work (the wever_triage checks sort, route and escalate a queue of work; a risk check assesses one planned action before it runs). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-risk-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-risk/.

kind.description: A wallet, a vendor, a position, a provider, a counterparty or other.

owner.description: Who stands behind that place when it differs, such as the custodian or parent company.

place.description: Where the action puts value, such as the one supplier.

unit.description: The unit amounts are counted in, such as USDC.

cap_percent.description: The most one place or owner may hold as a share of the total; 50 when left out.

holdings.description: What is already held or committed before the action, place by place; empty when nothing is.

id.description: The holding id, such as h1.

unit.description: Its unit; the action’s when left out.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

warn_percent.description: A share at or above this counts as elevated; 25 when left out.

name: wever_risk-concentration-check
title: Risk concentration check
